title: Tune-up race with Jordan
description: Demo conversation (synthetic, for the demo account). After a ten-kilometer tune-up race, Alex and Jordan go over pacing that went to plan, the knee holding up and the playlist, then set a recovery plan for the two weeks before the half marathon.

utterances.text: Ten k! Official race, official time. How does it feel to wear a bib?
I'm keeping it forever. Fifty-eight minutes and twelve seconds.
Under an hour! But I want to hear about the pacing.
That's the part I'm proudest of. I actually stuck to the plan.
Walk me through it.
First five k at long-run pace, six fifteens, even when everyone flew past me at the start.
That's the hard part. Everyone sprints off the line.
A guy dressed as a hot dog passed me in the first kilometer. I let him go.
Very mature. Did you catch him?
At kilometer eight. I passed the hot dog. Best moment of my life.
Ha. So the second half you sped up?
A little each kilometer, like you said. Five fifty, five forty, and the last one at five twenty.
That's a negative split. That's exactly how you want to race.
And the knee? Not a peep. A bit tight in the last kilometer, then fine.
The step-downs paid off. Did you do them this week?
Monday and Thursday. And I finally don't wobble on them.
What about the playlist?
Easy playlist for the first half, it kept me calm. Then I switched to the long-run one at five k.
And Saltwater?
Saved it for the last kilometer. I'm pretty sure I was mouthing the words.
Of course you were. Okay, recovery. This week matters as much as the race.
Rest day tomorrow, I know. Rest days are training.
Good. Then two short easy runs, really slow. Nothing fast. And sleep, aim for eight hours.
I've been at seven and a half. I'll push for eight.
Next Saturday, one last long run. Fourteen k, easy. Then we taper.
Taper means I run less and feel weird about it?
Exactly. Your legs get fresher and your brain gets nervous. Both are normal.
Half marathon in two weeks. I can't believe it's actually close.
Today told us you're ready. Same plan, just longer. Start slow, build, save Saltwater for the end.
And pass the hot dog.
